== Circlet ==

''Dialogue needed.''

Jaglorm promises to make you a cap if you bring him an [[Ancient Leather Cap]] and three [[Crushed Onyx Sapphire]]s.

== Tunic ==

''Dialogue needed.''

Jaglorm promises to make you a tunic if you bring him  an [[Ancient Leather Tunic]] and three pieces of [[Black Marble]].

== Sleeves ==

''Dialogue needed.''

Jaglorm promises to make you some sleeves if you bring him a pair of an [[Ancient Leather Sleeves]] and three [[Jaundice Gem]]s.

== Bracer ==

''Dialogue needed.''

Jaglorm promises to make you a bracer if you bring him an [[Ancient Leather Bracelet]], and three [[Crushed Opal]]s.

== Gauntlets ==

''Dialogue needed.''

Jaglorm promises to make you some gloves if you bring him a pair of an [[Ancient Leather Gloves]] and three [[Crushed Lava Ruby]]s.

== Leggings ==

''Dialogue needed.''

Jaglorm promises to make you some leggings if you bring him a pair of an [[Ancient Leather Leggings]] as well as three [[Chipped Onyx Sapphire]]s.

== Boots ==

''Dialogue needed.''

Jaglorm promises to make you some boots if you bring him a pair of [[Ancient Leather Boots]] and three [[Crushed Flame Emerald]]s.
